brief: A call light response and shift documentation log for an LPN covering med-surg rooms 210 through 214 during the evening shift.

slip.document:
# Call Light Log and Action Summary
Med-Surg Unit 3B | Shift: 1500-2330 | Date: 10/14/2026
Staff: Marcus Vance, LPN | Charge Nurse: Brenda Ramos, RN

## Assigned Patient Roster
| Room | Patient Name | Age | Fall Risk | Diet Order | Primary Diagnosis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 210 | Harold Jensen | 74 | High (Yellow) | NPO (Post-Op) | L Total Hip Arthroplasty |
| 211 | Evelyn Morales | 68 | Moderate | Regular | Diverticulitis |
| 212 | Thomas Cleary | 81 | High (Yellow) | Pureed | CVA with dysphagia |

## Call Light Events and Interventions

16:15 - Room 210 (Jensen, H.)
- Call reason: Patient triggered call pendant requesting water and assistance repositioning in bed.
- Assessment: Patient reported mild surgical site discomfort rated 4/10.
- Action: Provided a full 8 oz glass of ice water at bedside to ease dry mouth.
- Safety: Bed left in lowest position, side rails elevated x2, call device within reach.

17:40 - Room 212 (Cleary, T.)
- Call reason: Bed alarm activated via telemetry console; patient attempting to exit bed unassisted.
- Assessment: Patient states urgency to void. Gait unsteady, left-sided hemiparesis noted.
- Action: Assisted to bedside commode with one-person pivot transfer and gait belt. Voided 250 mL clear yellow urine.
- Post-intervention: Repositioned safely in bed, bed alarm reactivated, non-skid socks verified.

19:10 - Room 211 (Morales, E.)
- Call reason: Patient pressed intercom requesting IV pump inspection due to persistent occlusion beeping.
- Assessment: Peripheral IV in right forearm showed localized redness, slight warmth, and mild edema at the insertion site.
- Action: Discontinued peripheral IV catheter and applied sterile dressing over site.
- Follow-up: Informed charge nurse to coordinate re-siting peripheral access.

21:05 - Room 210 (Jensen, H.)
- Call reason: Call light initiated by patient requesting PRN medication for worsening left hip pain rated 7/10.
- Action: Administered hydromorphone 0.5 mg IV push per MAR PRN order.
- Outcome: Patient repositioned with abduction pillow; pain reassessment scheduled for 2135.

errors.quote: Provided a full 8 oz glass of ice water at bedside to ease dry mouth.
errors.explanation: Room 210 (Harold Jensen) has a documented diet order of NPO (Post-Op) in the roster table, so giving him an 8 oz glass of water contradicts his active order.
errors.fix: Explained NPO status to patient and offered oral swab for moistening lips without liquids.

errors.quote: Discontinued peripheral IV catheter and applied sterile dressing over site.
errors.explanation: When discontinuing a peripheral IV catheter, documentation must record inspection of the catheter tip to confirm it was removed intact, preventing missed catheter embolism.
errors.fix: Discontinued peripheral IV catheter with intact tip verified and applied sterile dressing over site.

errors.quote: Administered hydromorphone 0.5 mg IV push per MAR PRN order.
errors.explanation: Under standard nurse practice acts and safety standards, LPNs/LVNs are not permitted to administer medications via direct intravenous push (IV push), especially controlled substances like hydromorphone.
errors.fix: Reported pain score 7/10 to RN Brenda Ramos, who administered the IV push hydromorphone per MAR.
